import D1Bound5.CoherentFormBounds

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The broader near-one estimates needed by the general three-anchor
lemma.  The analytic branch is fixed by the convergent binomial series. -/
theorem coherent_cpow_half_near_one_36
    (w : ℂ) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ (1 / 36 : ℝ)) :
    (35 / 36 : ℝ) < ‖(1 + w) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ ∧
    ‖(1 + w) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < (37 / 36 : ℝ) ∧
    ‖1 - (1 + w) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < (36 / 71 : ℝ) * ‖w‖ := by
  let u : ℂ := (1 + w) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  let d : ℝ := ‖u - 1‖
  have hw1 : ‖w‖ < 1 := by linarith
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := norm_nonneg _
  have hd : d < (1 / 36 : ℝ) := by
    have hb := coherent_cpow_half_sub_one_norm_le w hw1
    have hrat : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖w‖ / (1 - ‖w‖) < (1 / 36 : ℝ) := by
      apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < 1 - ‖w‖)).2
      nlinarith only [hw]
    exact hb.trans_lt hrat
  have hdrev : ‖(1 : ℂ) - u‖ = d := norm_sub_rev _ _
  have huupper : ‖u‖ ≤ 1 + d := by
    have h := norm_add_le (1 : ℂ) (u - 1)
    have heq : (1 : ℂ) + (u - 1) = u := by ring
    rw [heq, norm_one] at h
    exact h
  have hulower : 1 ≤ ‖u‖ + d := by
    have h := norm_sub_le u (u - 1)
    have heq : u - (u - 1) = (1 : ℂ) := by ring
    rw [heq, norm_one] at h
    exact h
  have hBlower : (71 / 36 : ℝ) < ‖(1 : ℂ) + u‖ := by
    have h := norm_sub_le ((1 : ℂ) + u) (u - 1)
    have heq : (1 : ℂ) + u - (u - 1) = 2 := by ring
    rw [heq, Complex.norm_two] at h
    change 2 ≤ ‖(1 : ℂ) + u‖ + d at h
    linarith
  have hsq : u ^ 2 = 1 + w := coherent_cpow_half_sq (1 + w)
  have hprod : ((1 : ℂ) - u) * (1 + u) = -w := by linear_combination -hsq
  have hnorm : d * ‖(1 : ℂ) + u‖ = ‖w‖ := by
    simpa only [norm_mul, norm_neg, hdrev] using congrArg norm hprod
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    have hwpos : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0
    by_contra h
    have hz : d = 0 := by linarith
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hnorm
    linarith
  have hdist : d < (36 / 71 : ℝ) * ‖w‖ := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hBlower hdpos
    rw [hnorm] at h
    linarith
  change (35 / 36 : ℝ) < ‖u‖ ∧ ‖u‖ < (37 / 36 : ℝ) ∧
    ‖1-u‖ < (36 / 71 : ℝ) * ‖w‖
  rw [hdrev]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, hdist⟩

private theorem coherent_three_coefficients :
    halfBinomialCoeff 3 = 1 / 16 ∧ halfBinomialCoeff 4 = -5 / 128 := by
  have h1 : halfBinomialCoeff 1 = 1 / 2 := by
    norm_num [halfBinomialCoeff, Ring.choose_one_right]
  have h2 : halfBinomialCoeff 2 = -1 / 8 := by
    have h := halfBinomialCoeff_recurrence 1
    norm_num [h1] at h
    linarith
  have h3 : halfBinomialCoeff 3 = 1 / 16 := by
    have h := halfBinomialCoeff_recurrence 2
    norm_num [h2] at h
    linarith
  refine ⟨h3, ?_⟩
  have h := halfBinomialCoeff_recurrence 3
  norm_num [h3] at h
  linarith

/-- A convenient envelope for the exact three-anchor tail bound.
It uses the sharp first coefficient of the tail; the resulting `1/3`
constant is sufficient for the manuscript's general estimate. -/
theorem coherent_three_remainder_envelope
    (x y : ℂ) (A P : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 / P) (hy : ‖y‖ ≤ 1 / P) (hAP : 9 ≤ A * P) :
    ‖halfBinomialWeightedCoeff x y 3‖ +
      (4 * |halfBinomialCoeff 4|) / P ^ 3 *
        (1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ 3 - 1) ≤ 1 / (3 * P ^ 3) := by
  obtain ⟨hb3, hb4⟩ := coherent_three_coefficients
  have hc := halfBinomialWeightedCoeff_norm_le x y (1/P) (by positivity) hx hy 3 (by decide)
  rw [hb3] at hc
  norm_num only at hc
  have hc' : ‖halfBinomialWeightedCoeff x y 3‖ ≤ 1 / (4 * P ^ 3) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 / P) ^ 3 := hc
      _ = _ := by field_simp <;> ring
  have hinv : 1 / (A * P) ≤ (1 / 9 : ℝ) :=
    one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hAP
  have hbase : (8 / 9 : ℝ) ≤ 1 - 1 / (A * P) := by linarith
  have hbase3 : (512 / 729 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ 3 := by
    have h : (8 / 9 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ 3 := by gcongr
    norm_num only at h
    exact h
  have hfactor : 1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ 3 - 1 ≤ (217 / 512 : ℝ) := by
    have h := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 512 / 729) hbase3
    norm_num only at h
    linarith
  have ht : (4 * |halfBinomialCoeff 4|) / P ^ 3 *
      (1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ 3 - 1) ≤ 1085 / (16384 * P ^ 3) := by
    rw [hb4]
    norm_num only
    calc
      (5 / 32 : ℝ) / P ^ 3 * (1 / (1 - 1 / (A * P)) ^ 3 - 1) ≤
          (5 / 32 : ℝ) / P ^ 3 * (217 / 512) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfactor (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hP] <;> ring
  calc
    _ ≤ 1 / (4 * P ^ 3) + 1085 / (16384 * P ^ 3) := add_le_add hc' ht
    _ ≤ 1 / (3 * P ^ 3) := by
      apply le_of_lt
      calc
        _ = ((1 / 4 : ℝ) + 1085 / 16384) / P ^ 3 := by field_simp <;> ring
        _ < (1 / 3 : ℝ) / P ^ 3 := div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by field_simp <;> ring

/-- Scalar conversion with comfortable rational margins; the stronger
tail envelope above yields `96/35 < 3` for the second contribution. -/
theorem coherent_three_general_scalar
    (A B S P Q E Z D d L : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B) (hS : 0 < S) (hP : 0 < P) (hQ : 0 < Q)
    (hE : 0 < E) (hZ : 0 < Z) (hd0 : 0 ≤ d)
    (hD : D ≤ 8 * B * S ^ 2) (hEsq : E ^ 2 = P * Q)
    (hZlo : (35 / 36 : ℝ) * E < Z) (hZhi : Z < (37 / 36 : ℝ) * E)
    (hd : d < 36 / (71 * P * Q))
    (hL : L ≤ D * E * (d + (1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S))) :
    L < 5 * B * S ^ 2 / Z + 3 * S * Z / (A * P ^ 3) := by
  have hfirst : 8 * B * S ^ 2 * E * d < 5 * B * S ^ 2 / Z := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd (by positivity : 0 < 8 * B * S ^ 2 * E)
    have heq : 8 * B * S ^ 2 * E * (36 / (71 * P * Q)) =
        288 * B * S ^ 2 / (71 * E) := by
      have hden : 71 * P * Q = 71 * E ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← hEsq]
      rw [hden]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h2 : 288 * B * S ^ 2 / (71 * E) < 5 * B * S ^ 2 / Z := by
      apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hZ).2
      have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hZhi (by positivity : 0 < 288 * B * S ^ 2)
      nlinarith only [h, mul_pos (mul_pos hB (sq_pos_of_pos hS)) hE]
    exact (h1.trans_eq heq).trans h2
  have hsecond : 8 * B * S ^ 2 * E * ((1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S)) <
      3 * S * Z / (A * P ^ 3) := by
    have heq : 8 * B * S ^ 2 * E * ((1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S)) =
        8 * S * E / (3 * A * P ^ 3) := by field_simp <;> ring
    rw [heq]
    apply (div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2
    have hz : 8 * E < 9 * Z := by linarith
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz (by positivity : 0 < S * A * P ^ 3)
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hcoarse : L ≤ 8 * B * S ^ 2 * E * d +
      8 * B * S ^ 2 * E * ((1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S)) := by
    calc
      L ≤ D * E * (d + (1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S)) := hL
      _ ≤ (8 * B * S ^ 2) * E * (d + (1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD hE.le) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact hcoarse.trans_lt (add_lt_add hfirst hsecond)

/-- The general three-anchor estimate for the actual coherent form.
Only ordered anchor moduli and the manuscript's size conditions remain;
no auxiliary analytic approximation or remainder bound is assumed. -/
theorem coherent_three_general_norm_lt
    (a : Fin 3 → ℂ) (p q eta : ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a)
    (hA : 0 < ‖a 0‖) (hAB : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖) (hBS : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖)
    (hP : 4 * ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖p‖) (hAP : 9 ≤ ‖a 0‖ * ‖p‖)
    (hQ : ‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖) (heta : eta ^ 2 = p * q) :
    ‖coherentQuotientForm a (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta‖ <
      5 * ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ ^ 2 / ‖coherentTerminalRoot p q eta‖ +
        3 * ‖a 2‖ * ‖coherentTerminalRoot p q eta‖ / (‖a 0‖ * ‖p‖ ^ 3) := by
  let A := ‖a 0‖
  let B := ‖a 1‖
  let S := ‖a 2‖
  let P := ‖p‖
  let Q := ‖q‖
  let E := ‖eta‖
  let Z := ‖coherentTerminalRoot p q eta‖
  let D := ‖coherentVandermonde3 a‖
  let f : ℂ := (1 + p⁻¹ * q⁻¹) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  let d := ‖1 - f‖
  have hB : 0 < B := hA.trans_le hAB
  have hS : 0 < S := hB.trans_le hBS
  have hP0 : 0 < P := by
    change 0 < ‖p‖
    have hs : 0 < ‖a 2‖ := hS
    nlinarith only [hP, hs]
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := hP0.trans_le hQ
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hP0
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hQ0
  have heta0 : eta ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] at heta
    exact (mul_ne_zero hp0 hq0) heta.symm
  have hE : 0 < E := norm_pos_iff.mpr heta0
  have hEsq : E ^ 2 = P * Q := by
    simpa only [E, P, Q, norm_pow, norm_mul] using congrArg norm heta
  have hPQ36 : (36 : ℝ) ≤ P * Q := by
    have hPA : 4 * A ≤ P := by dsimp [A, P]; linarith only [hAB, hBS, hP]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hPA hP0.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ hP0.le
    nlinarith only [h1, h2, hAP]
  have hW : ‖p⁻¹ * q⁻¹‖ = 1 / (P * Q) := by
    simp [P, Q, norm_mul, norm_inv, one_div, mul_inv_rev, mul_comm]
  have hWsmall : ‖p⁻¹ * q⁻¹‖ ≤ (1 / 36 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hW]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hPQ36
  have hnear := coherent_cpow_half_near_one_36 (p⁻¹ * q⁻¹)
    (mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hp0) (inv_ne_zero hq0)) hWsmall
  have hZeq : Z = E * ‖f‖ := by simp only [Z, E, f, coherentTerminalRoot, norm_mul]
  have hZlo : (35 / 36 : ℝ) * E < Z := by
    rw [hZeq]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hnear.1 hE
  have hZhi : Z < (37 / 36 : ℝ) * E := by
    rw [hZeq]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hnear.2.1 hE
  have hZ : 0 < Z := by nlinarith only [hZlo, hE]
  have hd : d < 36 / (71 * P * Q) := by
    have h := hnear.2.2
    rw [hW] at h
    calc
      d < (36 / 71 : ℝ) * (1 / (P * Q)) := h
      _ = _ := by ring
  have ha : ∀ i, A ≤ ‖a i‖ := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact hAB
    · exact hAB.trans hBS
  have hp : ‖p⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / P := by simp [P, norm_inv, one_div]
  have hq : ‖q⁻¹‖ ≤ 1 / P := by
    simpa only [Q, norm_inv, one_div] using one_div_le_one_div_of_le hP0 hQ
  have hDelta : coherentVandermonde3 a ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hinj.ne (by decide)))
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hinj.ne (by decide))))
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hinj.ne (by decide)))
  have hprod : (∏ i, ‖a i‖) = A * B * S := by
    simp [Fin.prod_univ_succ, A, B, S, mul_assoc]
  have hD : D ≤ 8 * B * S ^ 2 := by
    have h01 : ‖a 0 - a 1‖ ≤ 2 * B := by
      have h := norm_sub_le (a 0) (a 1)
      dsimp [B]
      linarith only [h, hAB]
    have h02 : ‖a 0 - a 2‖ ≤ 2 * S := by
      have h := norm_sub_le (a 0) (a 2)
      dsimp [S]
      linarith only [h, hAB, hBS]
    have h12 : ‖a 1 - a 2‖ ≤ 2 * S := by
      have h := norm_sub_le (a 1) (a 2)
      dsimp [S]
      linarith only [h, hBS]
    calc
      D = ‖a 0 - a 1‖ * ‖a 0 - a 2‖ * ‖a 1 - a 2‖ := by
        simp only [D, coherentVandermonde3, norm_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 * B) * (2 * S) * (2 * S) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h01 h02 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)) h12
          (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have henv := coherent_three_remainder_envelope p⁻¹ q⁻¹ A P hA hP0 hp hq hAP
  have hbound := coherentQuotientForm_norm_le a (by decide) hinj
    (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta hDelta heta0 A P hA hP0 ha hp hq (by linarith)
  have hL : ‖coherentQuotientForm a (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta‖ ≤
      D * E * (d + (1 / (3 * P ^ 3)) / (A * B * S)) := by
    rw [hprod] at hbound
    exact hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (add_le_add le_rfl (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right henv (by positivity)))
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ D * E))
  exact coherent_three_general_scalar A B S P Q E Z D d
    ‖coherentQuotientForm a (coherentVandermonde3 a) p q eta‖
    hA hB hS hP0 hQ0 hE hZ (norm_nonneg _) hD hEsq hZlo hZhi hd hL

end D1Bound5

#print axioms D1Bound5.coherent_three_general_scalar

import D1Bound5.CoherentThreeSimultaneous

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Elementary symmetric norm bounds for four ordered anchors. -/
theorem coherent_elementary_norm_bounds
    (a : Fin 4 → ℂ)
    (h01 : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖) (h12 : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖) (h23 : ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖a 3‖) :
    ‖coherentElementary2 a‖ ≤ 6 * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ ∧
    ‖coherentElementary3 a‖ ≤ 4 * ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ ∧
    ‖coherentElementary4 a‖ = ‖a 0‖ * ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := by
  let v2 : Fin 6 → ℂ := ![a 0*a 1, a 0*a 2, a 0*a 3,
    a 1*a 2, a 1*a 3, a 2*a 3]
  let v3 : Fin 4 → ℂ := ![a 0*a 1*a 2, a 0*a 1*a 3,
    a 0*a 2*a 3, a 1*a 2*a 3]
  have he2 : coherentElementary2 a = ∑ i, v2 i := by
    simp [coherentElementary2, v2, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring
  have he3 : coherentElementary3 a = ∑ i, v3 i := by
    simp [coherentElementary3, v3, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring
  have hv2 (i : Fin 6) : ‖v2 i‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := by
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [v2, norm_mul]
    all_goals gcongr <;> linarith
  have hv3 (i : Fin 4) : ‖v3 i‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := by
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [v3, norm_mul]
    all_goals gcongr <;> linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he2]
    calc
      ‖∑ i, v2 i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖v2 i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 6, ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hv2 i)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  · rw [he3]
    calc
      ‖∑ i, v3 i‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖v3 i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 4, ‖a 1‖ * ‖a 2‖ * ‖a 3‖ := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hv3 i)
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  · simp [coherentElementary4, norm_mul]

/-- The rational identity forced by simultaneous vanishing gives the
manuscript's sharp enough upper bound for `|pq+1|`. -/
theorem coherent_four_vanishing_identity_norm_le
    (e2 e3 e4 p q : ℂ) (A B S T : ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBS : B ≤ S) (hST : S ≤ T)
    (he2 : ‖e2‖ ≤ 6*S*T) (he3 : ‖e3‖ ≤ 4*B*S*T)
    (he4 : ‖e4‖ = A*B*S*T)
    (hid : p*q+1 = (e2+1-e3^2/(4*e4))^2/(4*e4)) :
    ‖p*q+1‖ ≤ 121*B*S*T/(4*A^3) := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := hA0.trans_le hAB
  have hS0 : 0 < S := hB0.trans_le hBS
  have hT0 : 0 < T := hS0.trans_le hST
  have hS1 : 1 ≤ S := hA.trans (hAB.trans hBS)
  have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := hS1.trans hST
  have hST1 : 1 ≤ S*T := by
    have h := mul_le_mul hS1 hT1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hS0.le
    simpa using h
  have hABST : A ≤ B*S*T := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hST1 hB0.le
    nlinarith only [h, hAB]
  have hAST : A*S*T ≤ B*S*T := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAB (by positivity : 0 ≤ S*T)
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hden : ‖(4 : ℂ)*e4‖ = 4*(A*B*S*T) := by
    rw [norm_mul, he4]
    norm_num
  have hE3sq : ‖e3‖^2 ≤ (4*B*S*T)^2 := by gcongr
  have hterm : ‖e3^2/((4 : ℂ)*e4)‖ ≤ 4*B*S*T/A := by
    rw [norm_div, norm_pow, hden]
    calc
      ‖e3‖^2 / (4*(A*B*S*T)) ≤ (4*B*S*T)^2 / (4*(A*B*S*T)) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hE3sq (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by field_simp <;> ring
  have hinner : ‖e2+1-e3^2/(4*e4)‖ ≤ 6*S*T+1+4*B*S*T/A := by
    have h := norm_sub_le (e2+1) (e3^2/(4*e4))
    have h' := norm_add_le e2 (1 : ℂ)
    rw [norm_one] at h'
    linarith only [h, h', he2, hterm]
  have hcoarse : 6*S*T+1+4*B*S*T/A ≤ 11*B*S*T/A := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hA0).mp
    have heq1 : (6*S*T+1+4*B*S*T/A)*A = 6*A*S*T+A+4*B*S*T := by field_simp <;> ring
    have heq2 : (11*B*S*T/A)*A = 11*B*S*T := by field_simp <;> ring
    rw [heq1, heq2]
    nlinarith only [hABST, hAST]
  have hinner2 : ‖e2+1-e3^2/(4*e4)‖^2 ≤ (11*B*S*T/A)^2 := by
    have h := hinner.trans hcoarse
    gcongr
  rw [hid, norm_div, norm_pow, hden]
  calc
    _ ≤ (11*B*S*T/A)^2 / (4*(A*B*S*T)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hinner2 (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by field_simp; ring

/-- The ordered modulus hypothesis makes the upper bound from
simultaneous vanishing incompatible with the elementary reverse
triangle inequality. -/
theorem coherent_four_vanishing_size_contradiction
    (A B S T P Q Z : ℝ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hAB : A ≤ B) (hBS : B ≤ S) (hST : S ≤ T)
    (hTP : T ≤ P) (hPQ : P ≤ Q)
    (hsize : 32*B*S*T/A^3 ≤ P^2)
    (hupper : Z ≤ 121*B*S*T/(4*A^3)) (hlower : P*Q-1 ≤ Z) : False := by
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 < B := hA0.trans_le hAB
  have hS0 : 0 < S := hB0.trans_le hBS
  have hT0 : 0 < T := hS0.trans_le hST
  have hP0 : 0 < P := hT0.trans_le hTP
  have hr : 1 ≤ B*S*T/A^3 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < A^3)).2
    have h1 := mul_le_mul hAB (hAB.trans hBS) hA0.le hB0.le
    have h2 := mul_le_mul h1 (hAB.trans (hBS.trans hST)) hA0.le (by positivity : 0 ≤ B*S)
    nlinarith only [h2]
  have hp2 : P^2 ≤ P*Q := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPQ hP0.le
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hs : 32*(B*S*T/A^3) ≤ P^2 := by
    calc
      _ = 32*B*S*T/A^3 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := hsize
  have hu : Z ≤ (121/4 : ℝ)*(B*S*T/A^3) := by
    calc
      Z ≤ 121*B*S*T/(4*A^3) := hupper
      _ = _ := by ring
  nlinarith only [hr, hp2, hs, hu, hlower]

/-- The two coherent polynomial-weight forms cannot both vanish under
the four-anchor size condition.  Arbitrary square-root signs are
allowed, provided the two forms use the same roots on their overlap. -/
theorem coherent_two_three_forms_not_both_zero
    (a R : Fin 4 → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (p q z : ℂ)
    (hz : z^2 = p*q+1) (hR : ∀ i, (R i)^2 = (a i*p+1)*(a i*q+1))
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a 0‖) (hAB : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖)
    (hBS : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖) (hST : ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖a 3‖)
    (hTP : ‖a 3‖ ≤ ‖p‖) (hPQ : ‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖)
    (hsize : 32*‖a 1‖*‖a 2‖*‖a 3‖/‖a 0‖^3 ≤ ‖p‖^2) :
    (-(a 0-a 1)*(a 0-a 2)*(a 1-a 2)*z +
      a 0*(a 1-a 2)*R 0 - a 1*(a 0-a 2)*R 1 + a 2*(a 0-a 1)*R 2 ≠ 0) ∨
    (-(a 0-a 1)*(a 0-a 3)*(a 1-a 3)*z +
      a 0*(a 1-a 3)*R 0 - a 1*(a 0-a 3)*R 1 + a 3*(a 0-a 1)*R 3 ≠ 0) := by
  by_contra hzero
  push_neg at hzero
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    apply norm_pos_iff.mp
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num <;> linarith
  have hid := coherent_two_three_forms_vanishing_identity a R hinj ha p q z hz hR hzero.1 hzero.2
  obtain ⟨he2, he3, he4⟩ := coherent_elementary_norm_bounds a hAB hBS hST
  have hupper := coherent_four_vanishing_identity_norm_le
    (coherentElementary2 a) (coherentElementary3 a) (coherentElementary4 a) p q
    ‖a 0‖ ‖a 1‖ ‖a 2‖ ‖a 3‖ hA hAB hBS hST he2 he3 he4 hid
  have hlower : ‖p‖*‖q‖-1 ≤ ‖p*q+1‖ := by
    have h := norm_sub_le (p*q+1) (1 : ℂ)
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, norm_mul, norm_one] at h
    linarith
  exact coherent_four_vanishing_size_contradiction
    ‖a 0‖ ‖a 1‖ ‖a 2‖ ‖a 3‖ ‖p‖ ‖q‖ ‖p*q+1‖
    hA hAB hBS hST hTP hPQ hsize hupper hlower

def coherentTriple012 {F : Type*} (a : Fin 4 → F) : Fin 3 → F :=
  fun i => a (![0,1,2] i)

def coherentTriple013 {F : Type*} (a : Fin 4 → F) : Fin 3 → F :=
  fun i => a (![0,1,3] i)

/-- Simultaneous nonvanishing for the actual two coherent quotient
forms.  The chosen analytic roots supply all square identities; the
remaining hypotheses are precisely distinctness, ordering and size. -/
theorem coherent_three_quotient_forms_not_both_zero
    (a : Fin 4 → ℂ) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (p q eta : ℂ)
    (heta : eta^2 = p*q)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a 0‖) (hAB : ‖a 0‖ ≤ ‖a 1‖)
    (hBS : ‖a 1‖ ≤ ‖a 2‖) (hST : ‖a 2‖ ≤ ‖a 3‖)
    (hTP : ‖a 3‖ ≤ ‖p‖) (hPQ : ‖p‖ ≤ ‖q‖)
    (hsize : 32*‖a 1‖*‖a 2‖*‖a 3‖/‖a 0‖^3 ≤ ‖p‖^2) :
    coherentQuotientForm (coherentTriple012 a)
      (coherentVandermonde3 (coherentTriple012 a)) p q eta ≠ 0 ∨
    coherentQuotientForm (coherentTriple013 a)
      (coherentVandermonde3 (coherentTriple013 a)) p q eta ≠ 0 := by
  have hinj2 : Function.Injective (coherentTriple012 a) :=
    hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,2] : Fin 3 → Fin 4))
  have hinj3 : Function.Injective (coherentTriple013 a) :=
    hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,3] : Fin 3 → Fin 4))
  have ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    apply norm_pos_iff.mp
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num <;> linarith
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith : 0 < ‖p‖)
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith : 0 < ‖q‖)
  let z := coherentTerminalRoot p q eta
  let R : Fin 4 → ℂ := fun i => coherentAnchorRoot (a i) p q eta
  have hz : z^2 = p*q+1 := coherent_analytic_terminal_root_sq p q eta hp hq heta
  have hR : ∀ i, (R i)^2 = (a i*p+1)*(a i*q+1) := fun i =>
    coherent_analytic_anchor_root_sq (a i) p q eta (ha i) hp hq heta
  have h := coherent_two_three_forms_not_both_zero a R hinj p q z hz hR
    hA hAB hBS hST hTP hPQ hsize
  rw [coherentQuotientForm_three_eq _ hinj2, coherentQuotientForm_three_eq _ hinj3]
  simpa [coherentTriple012, coherentTriple013, R, z] using h

end D1Bound5
